# André Ringdorfer (苏文)

> Senior product manager in onchain finance, based in Hong Kong. He runs a team of AI agents from a Raspberry Pi that keep working around the clock. Before AI, he shipped crypto products. Before crypto, he worked in strategy consulting and corporate strategy across Europe and Asia.

Pages:
- [AI work](https://andre-ringdorfer.com/): the AI agents and projects.
- [Experience](https://andre-ringdorfer.com/experience.html): results, work history, education and languages.

## AI work
- The Forge: an AI engineer that works around the clock. It picks up tasks, writes the code and hands it in for review. Some of André's own products are partly maintained by it.
- GoodInGoodOut: a calorie tracker you talk to. Describe a meal and it logs every part of it. The iOS app is on its way.
- Portfolio dashboard: every account, wallet and position, pulled in automatically and aggregated into one live dashboard.
- AI video studio: generates video, then a second AI critiques every clip. Only the best takes make the cut.
- Smaller projects: Keepr (a personal CRM you text), AEO toolkit (makes websites readable by AI answer engines), Build-your-Bob (the shared framework behind his bots), Date Doctor, Polymarket monitor, DoomDraft.

## Strongest results (US dollars)
- Sherpa Stake: a staking platform he built; over US$1 billion in tokens staked at its peak.
- Chakra Pool: savings vaults he built and scaled; US$18 million+ deposited.
- HeliSwap: Hedera's first native crypto exchange, which he led; US$7 million+ in deposits within months, and a US$2.5 million Hedera Foundation grant he secured.
- Developer course with Metaschool: 7,000+ developers onboarded to MANTRA Chain.
- RWAccelerator with Google Cloud: founded and led it; picked 7 startups from 150+ applicants and took them to launch.
- ETHGlobal hackathons: US$14,000+ in prizes.

## Experience

- 2019–2020: Strategic Project Management, PayPal, London
